decision: The functional journey is already qualified, but the exact authoritative TUI route does not satisfy the required very-little-typing and all-choices-selection-driven acceptance phrase.

covered: rollback, removal, privacy, cleanup, hosted checks

focused_reproduction.command_class: cargo +1.93.0 test --locked, exact single integration test

not_selection_driven: credential-reference handoff in the exact qualified route
interaction_audit.authentication_note: The development fixture has a one-key F action, but the exact OpenRouter credential-reference journey under qualification enters the reference as 85 characters; this does not repair the other free-form fields.

documentation_lookup_audit.conclusion: The hermetic regression receives fixture catalogs and key events only. However, its free-form literals are supplied by test code rather than selected from visible supported choices, so it cannot prove that a fresh user needs no documentation lookup.

acceptance.functional_install_to_comparison: passed by the bound AR-1668 exact-main receipt

scope: replace free-form configuration defaults with bounded supported selections or valid preselected defaults
make credential-reference handoff selectable without typing the digest/reference
replace recording-mode free-form text with enumerated choices
replace replay-policy free-form text with enumerated choices
add a reproducible authoritative-renderer action counter that fails when unsupported free-form typing is reintroduced
required_repair.requalification: Rerun AR-1597 at exact current main, bind the result to the completed journey receipt, require independent review, and preserve the no-documentation/no-network harness boundary.
